- **Thursday 14:00–14:30**

Of your other two: Thursday 14:00-14:30 clashes with the Curriculum committee (14:20-15:20), and Wednesday 15:00-15:30 is still open on his side — so if Monday has to move, Wednesday 15:00-15:30 is the fallback.

Noted: **Thu 14:00–14:30** preferred, **Mon 14:00–14:30** as backup — I passed that on to Prof. Alvarez. I'll book his pick, log it in CALENDAR.md, and confirm here.

Thanks — but Thursday won't work: 14:00-14:30 runs into the professor's Curriculum committee (14:20-15:20), and he doesn't start anything that overlaps.

So the pick stays **Monday 14:00-14:30** (Wednesday 15:00-15:30 if Monday ever has to move).

Please confirm Monday 14:00-14:30 in Sarah's calendar — it's booked on his side. Sorry about the Reading-group nicety; his Thursday is the one day that's wall-to-wall.

Perfect — **Monday 14:00–14:30** it is, confirmed on Sarah's side too. I've written it into her calendar and logged it. If it ever has to move, Wednesday 15:00–15:30 is the fallback.

Anytime. I'll flag it if Alvarez ever has to move it — otherwise I'm here whenever you need something.
